やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: A meeting is being recorded right now. The app has just started capturing audio 2 seconds in, and is actively listening for speech. It's organizing content into decision items and action items, though none have been captured yet.
answers.q2: The meeting time (14:50), the recording status (active, 00:02), and that the AI is in listening mode. These establish the task context immediately.
answers.q3: Wait for the app to transcribe speech, then review transcriptions, translations, or subtitles in the right panel. You can also access real-time summaries, view decisions and action items as they emerge, or ask questions about the meeting.
answers.q4: Partly. The listening indicator and progress visualization suggest the app is active, but the 'no speech yet' message at 2 seconds creates uncertainty—is the microphone working? Should I be speaking? The empty categorized panels make it unclear if capture is functioning.
answers.q5: The Translation and Subtitles tabs feel premature when no transcription exists yet. The right-panel layout would benefit from guidance text. Some buttons (実開する, 決定書類) have unclear purpose without additional context.
answers.q6: The red recording indicator and timer catch attention first, followed immediately by the meeting title (14:50の会議). The floating control bar anchors the eye to the top.

weaknesses.what: At 2 seconds with 'no speech yet', users cannot tell if the microphone is working, if they should speak, or if something is wrong.
weaknesses.fix: Add guidance text: 'Ready to listen' or 'Waiting for speech' with a microphone status indicator (e.g., animated waveform or pulsing dot) to signal active capture.

weaknesses.what: The transition from empty panels to populated content is unclear—no visual signals or skeleton states guide the user's expectation.
weaknesses.fix: Show skeleton loaders or animated placeholders in decision/action sections so users understand the app is actively populating them.

weaknesses.what: Tabs (翻訳, 字幕) and buttons (実開する, 決定書類) are present but non-functional or unclear in an empty state, wasting visual real estate.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or disable unavailable tabs/buttons until content exists. Or, replace the empty right panel with a single focused call-to-action during the listening phase.

weaknesses.what: The button labels are cryptic (実開する, 決定書類, アクション) and their interaction model is unclear without explanation.
weaknesses.fix: Add tooltips or use more explicit labels. Surface the most important actions (e.g., view summary) prominently.
